an8.85:1.1: bhikkhave Tathāgatass' etaṃ adhivacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa,
an8.85:1.2: ‘brāhmaṇo' ti bhikkhave Tathāgatass' etaṃ adhivacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa,
an8.85:1.3: ‘vedagū' ti bhikkhave Tathāgatass' etaṃ adhivacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa,
an8.85:1.4: ‘bhisakko' ti bhikkhave Tathāgatass' etaṃ adhivacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa,
an8.85:1.5: ‘nimmalo' ti bhikkhave Tathāgatass' etaṃ adhivacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa,
an8.85:1.6: ‘vimalo' ti bhikkhave Tathāgatass' etaṃ adhivacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa,
an8.85:1.7: ‘ñāṇī' ti bhikkhave Tathāgatass' etaṃ adhivacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassa,
an8.85:1.8: ‘vimutto' ti bhikkhave Tathāgatass' etaṃ adhivacanaṃ arahato sammāsambuddhassā ti.
